notes.title: The Trial at Visual Novel Fest 2023!
notes.content:
[b]The Trial[/b] at [b]Visual Novel Fest 2023![/b]

"Someone must have been telling lies about Josef K., he knew he had done nothing wrong but, one morning, he was arrested."
Story about life, choices and a Man vs the System. This unique interactive literature adaptation. A game, brought to You in early visual novel, text-adventure style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176625/3c528dcd024e2ef4ea782e0d1efb661b00512a0c.jpg[/img]

If You wish to support Visual Novels, Text-Adventures and Interactive Fiction, Follow and Wishlist The Trial, let Your Friends and Colleagues know too :)

This game is a step to bring more literature to Gamers around the World.
Original text is treated with respect and as close to the original as possible.

Check our other titles and All the Best!
